svg.aria-label: The layers of load balancing for one request. DNS or anycast sends the user to the nearest region. A layer-4 load balancer spreads TCP connections by IP address and port without reading them, very fast. A layer-7 load balancer terminates TLS, reads the HTTP request and routes by path: /api to the API servers, /img to the image service. Each pool of servers is health-checked and unhealthy servers stop receiving traffic.

svg.text: health checks every few seconds; failing servers removed
